now.title: WandaVision

now.on_b_card_about_a: Poses as Wanda's neighbor Agnes. Wanda beats her and traps her in the Agnes persona.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's nosy neighbor Agnes, who helps her settle in.

split.title: WandaVision#7
split.text: Agnes reveals herself to Wanda as the witch Agatha Harkness, who has been meddling in her life, from the fake Pietro to Sparky's death.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Agatha has been meddling with as the nosy neighbor Agnes.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's neighbor Agnes, really a witch who has been meddling in her life.

split.title: WandaVision#9

split.on_b_card_about_a: Poses as Wanda's neighbor Agnes. Wanda beats her and traps her in the Agnes persona.

changes.evidence: The stage starts at WandaVision episode 1 but tells the episode 7 reveal and the episode 9 fight. Ep1: Agnes introduces herself and helps Wanda prepare for the evening; ep7: Agnes reveals she is the witch Agatha Harkness and has been disrupting Wanda's life, including sending the imposter Pietro and killing Sparky; ep9: Agatha tries to take Wanda's chaos magic and Wanda traps her in the Agnes persona.

now.title: Agatha All Along
now.text: Years later Billy, now living in William Kaplan's body, follows Agatha Harkness down the Witches' Road. She tries to take his power, but in the end she gives her life for him and stays on as his ghostly guide.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Wanda's son, reborn as William Kaplan. Agatha dies for him, then guides him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Billy's guide on the Witches' Road. She gives her life for him.

split.title: Agatha All Along#6

changes.evidence: The stage starts at Agatha All Along episode 1 (Teen breaks into Agnes's house; ep2 they set off on the Road) but names Billy in William Kaplan's body (revealed ep6), Agatha's death for him (ep8: Billy gives Agatha some of his power, Rio makes them choose, Agatha kisses Rio and dies) and her ghostly guidance (ep9: Billy relents and lets Agatha guide him; they set out to find Tommy). The sibling pair agatha|tommy already stages ep8 and ep9 separately.

In Blade (1998) Mercury attacks Blade and Karen after the visit to Pearl and they escape when Whistler arrives; at the Temple of Eternal Night Mercury attacks Karen, who kills her with Whistler's garlic spray (blade fandom Karen Jenson and Mercury pages; the Mercury page is in 'Characters Killed by Karen Jenson').

owner_calls.question: Stage 0 (titled 'Blade: The Series', so from the pilot) tells Marcus's bomb on Charlotte's plane, but Charlotte first appears in ep6 and the bomb comes late in the season, after stage 1 (#6, Charlotte confronts Marcus about Aurora). How should the stages be reordered?
options: Stage 0 becomes #6 (confrontation over Aurora); the plane bomb moves to a later stage at #12 'Monsters', where Blade and Collins hunt the surviving Charlotte
Stage 0 becomes #6 (confrontation); the plane bomb moves to #11 'Hunters'
owner_calls.evidence: Blade fandom: Charlotte's appearances are The Evil Within (6), Delivery (7), Sacrifice (8), Angels and Demons (10), Hunters (11), Monsters (12). Marcus page: after Aurora's pureblood test succeeds and he kills Damek, he tries to kill Charlotte with a bomb on her plane; she survives and warns the purebloods. Ep12 synopsis: 'Blade and Detective Collins team up to track down Pureblood Charlotte.' No episode synopsis names the bomb's episode.
